response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile full-stack/systems engineer with roughly 15+ years of experience and clear craftsmanship, open-source, and mentoring credentials, but his profile is misaligned with this Director-level Principal Engineer AI Strategy role. He lacks demonstrated deep AI/ML expertise, recognized AI thought leadership, cloud strategy work, or experience advising strategic customers/partners on AI adoption — the core requirements of this position. His recent AI-agent tooling exposure at re:cinq is minor relative to the seniority and specialization expected.
strengths: 15+ years of broad, hands-on engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Strong software craftsmanship background (TDD, CI/CD, open source, teaching/workshops)
Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit via founding GISCollective and building products independently
concerns: No evidence of recognized AI/ML expertise or AI-built products/platforms
No cloud strategy, advisory, or executive-facing customer/partner experience
Career trajectory is IC/senior developer level, not director-level strategic leadership

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI/ML specialization and recognized expertise
No cloud strategy or strategic customer advisory experience
Long, broad engineering tenure and craftsmanship reputation
